title: MetadataChangeProposal
description: A metadata change proposal (MCP) representing a proposed change to the metadata graph. MCPs are the standard format for ingesting metadata into DataHub and are processed asynchronously.

entityUrn.description: The unique URN identifier for the target entity.

entityType.description: The type of the target entity.

aspectName.description: The name of the aspect being changed.

changeType.description: The type of change being proposed.

aspect.description: The new aspect value following its PDL schema definition.
